rule_applied: Selected 16 Apache Calcite releases (1.0.0–1.15.0) from the larger SmartSHARK prepared release archive.
Retained file identifier, Java metrics, size, defect labels, MOSER process metrics, release version, and issue severity; excluded thousands of unrelated source columns.
result_or_audit: Only fields needed for the assignment-adapted analysis are in the analysis table.

rule_applied: Used one row per module file per release. Component was derived from the package path and release order from semantic versions.
Missing BUGFIX_count values were interpreted as zero for this prepared source; nonnegative counts retained. Severity issue identifiers were deduplicated within file and release.
result_or_audit: 2138 defect labels; severity JSON reconciles with zero mismatch rows.

rule_applied: Selected only Java records; checked size and complexity for negative values.
result_or_audit: Non-Java rows: 0; negative size: 0; negative WMC: 0 .

rule_applied: Kept extreme valid values and reported the 99th-percentile threshold instead of deleting outliers.
Kept MOSER_sum_code_churn as signed net additions minus deletions. Negative values are meaningful; they are not treated as invalid or as total volume.
Derived change_volume_proxy = MOSER_sum_lines_added + MOSER_sum_lines_deleted to represent additions-plus-deletions activity; labeled as a proxy.
Deduplicated repeated issue IDs per file-release before severity aggregation. Unmatched JSON module paths checked against release rows.
result_or_audit: No unmatched severity file paths; defect count and issue severity totals reconcile.

rule_applied: Did not create synthetic test coverage or calendar dates. Used release sequence for trends.
result_or_audit: Coverage and release dates are explicitly unavailable.
